newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end lower, more weakness seen.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end lower, more weakness seen.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures ended the week on softer ground after failing to climb back above a key support level despite the dollar's firm tone against the yen.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract finished 50 points above its intra-day low of 21,100 against a previous settlement at 21,355. Volume was a low 13,780 lots.
"There were heavy offers from U.S. houses around 21,300/320 in Chicago and its looks like they spilled over onto SIMEX," said a dealer with a Japanese institution.
"It's looking weak technically, but fundamentally I can't find any reason to sell," he said, adding that the December Nikkei looked set to drift lower to cover a gap on the charts around 20,945.
"If 21,070 is supported, at best we'll go to 21,350 again," he said, adding that 21,650 remained an important resistance.
Dealers said the market was likely to take its cue from the Dow's performance after the release of crucial U.S. jobs data at 1230 GMT on Friday.
